open-data CSV; body parsed by RegistryCsvParser (header
id;nimi;aadress;lest_x;lest_y enforced - a wrong header is a
deterministic no-retry failure; malformed rows dropped + counted);

-> WGS84 via LEst97Transformer (an unresolvable row is rejected per
row, counted as skipped, retained - never guessed); Last-Modified
parse(fitting dtos) ' rows over the column limits counted as skipped first
